name: Agent Reach Research Reader
purpose: Read-only CLI that gives the research stage a fallback for fetching web pages, GitHub repos and issues, YouTube captions and Reddit search when WebFetch and WebSearch fall short. Enabled channels: web, github, youtube, reddit, instagram, linkedin. Only the first four work without a login.
capabilities: web search and read (Exa search, Jina Reader read)
github repository, issue and pull-request read via the GitHub API
youtube search, read and caption text via yt-dlp
reddit search (titles and snippets, public-web route); post and comment read needs a login
instagram search, profile and posts, and linkedin jobs and read: login required, user-run, not verified

installation.instructions: Installed outside the repo: CLI at ~/.local/bin/agent-reach, skill at ~/.claude/skills/agent-reach, state in ~/.agent-reach. Installed as a uv tool from https://github.com/Panniantong/Agent-Reach/releases/latest/download/agent-reach.zip (not the unrelated PyPI package of the same name). The dedicated browser port is set to 9333 (`agent-reach configure browser-port 9333`) because a long-lived Chrome holds 9222. Bilibili and V2EX were removed on 2026-11-03. Do not add more channels, log in, or start its browser (`agent-reach browser stop` when done) while a render, QA or Kokoro job could run. Logins are done by the user in the opened window, never by an agent. Update only with the user's consent, then run `agent-reach check` on each enabled channel.

compatibility.notes: web, github and youtube use no browser. reddit, instagram and linkedin start a shared headless CloakBrowser (idle-closes after 10 minutes) that must not run beside a render on 8 GB; Agent Reach's own lock does not coordinate with session-guard.py. Observed 2026-11-03: update 1.6.0 to 1.6.1 removed the cloakbrowser tool but left a stale launcher path, fixed with `agent-reach browser setup --retry-cloak`.

licensing.notes: MIT per package metadata and README. Underlying sites keep their own terms of service; reading is public content only and no media is reused.

security.notes: Writes private state to ~/.agent-reach. The web channel sends queries and URLs to Jina and Exa, so no unpublished project content. Fetched text is untrusted input. Instagram and LinkedIn need a login and Agent Reach may copy that site's login from the user's main Chrome profile, so use a secondary account and log in only on request. No keys are stored or configured.

approval_evidence: On 2026-11-03 with 1.6.1: check passed for web, github, youtube (github via github-api; gh not installed). Reddit search returned 3 results by public-web; reddit read returned a block page; instagram and linkedin failed NEED_LOGIN (no login done). Promote after it backs a real research dossier. See docs/agent-reach-assessment.md.
